text:
harper: SmallBank wants a quick POC: websocket streaming with reconnect/resume, function-calls to their webhook, and bounded batching (tail <150ms). Pricing + security are blockers. Can eng confirm approach?

mohit: yes — SDKs support reconnect headers. pattern: session-id + resume-index + call-id for tool calls. hosted resume TTL default 30s for POC.

jen: for webhooks recommend X-Redwood-Call-Id to make calls idempotent. if they can't change webhooks we can enable a dedupe log on Dedicated.

harper: security Q: do resume blobs store prompts? retention? keys?

sec: brief answer: resume blobs store KV-deltas + token indices + checksum, not plaintext prompts. hosted: encrypted with our KMS envelope keys, TTL 30s (POC). Dedicated/private: support customer-managed KMS. audit logs record resume access.

ops-bot: perf note: staging-poc canary: reconnect->resume success 95% under 60 concurrent streams; median resume latency 11ms. Dedicated option: persist resume-state in local redis to improve tail predictability.

mohit: tool-calls caveat: side-effects not replayed by default. suggest call-id + idempotent webhooks. for POC we can enable a small call-log to dedupe.

harper: pricing: customer estimate: 350k tokens over 2 weeks, expect ~5% resumes. what to offer?

jen: suggest trial credit covering up to 1.05x tokens to account for some replays. hosted billing per-token; resumed tokens only billed if regenerated. Dedicated: reserved capacity for latency SLOs, separate pricing.

harper: thanks — Mohit/Jen please draft a one-pager + node snippet showing reconnect headers and call-id. Sec please add short answers for questionnaire. I'll send to SmallBank after review. :thumbsup:
